breaking_news.headline: Nvidia shares tumble as the company says it's investigating CEO Jensen Huang
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia's share price falls after the company begins an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's alleged relationship with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.

breaking_news.headline: Why did California's billionaire tax fail to surf the blue wave?
breaking_news.summary: Two economists debate what California's vote on Prop 40 means for the wealth tax movement.

breaking_news.headline: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
breaking_news.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

breaking_news.headline: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
breaking_news.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

breaking_news.headline: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
breaking_news.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

breaking_news.headline: Should you trust new AI agents with your money and data?
breaking_news.summary: Tech companies want agentic AI to be the new way you shop. But should you trust AI when your money's involved?

breaking_news.headline: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.

breaking_news.headline: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
breaking_news.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

breaking_news.headline: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
breaking_news.summary: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

breaking_news.headline: Haitian PM praises El Salvador after joint strike on alleged home of gang leader
breaking_news.summary: The 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by El Salvador's military, which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.

breaking_news.headline: Vinícius Jr sends message to Sudan boy who received prosthetic legs after BBC report sparks appeal
breaking_news.summary: Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again.

breaking_news.headline: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
breaking_news.summary: The 82-year-old was placed under house detention in Florida last week after being charged over possession of child sex abuse material.

breaking_news.headline: Hundreds of Italian schools hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
breaking_news.summary: Emails containing the false warnings were sent to schools in Rome, Naples, Vicenza, Florence, Pisa, Trieste and other Italian cities, officials say.

breaking_news.headline: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
breaking_news.summary: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

breaking_news.headline: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth
breaking_news.summary: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.

breaking_news.headline: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
breaking_news.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

breaking_news.headline: US inflation higher than expected in October - here's what is happening with prices
breaking_news.summary: Prices rose by 0.4% over the month, driven by increases in shelter, food and energy costs.

breaking_news.headline: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash
breaking_news.summary: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.

breaking_news.headline: Robot vessels take on the dangerous work of mine hunting
breaking_news.summary: The conflict in the Gulf is an opportunity for the US to test its autonomous mine-hunting systems.

breaking_news.headline: Sales of tinned food and bottled water  jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
